parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description: The domain name to delete. The domain name must exist in Alibaba Cloud DNS. Call the [DescribeDomains](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomains?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d_0) operation to obtain existing domain names.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh: Chinese

- en: English

Default value: en.
